correctness.rationale: For any connected chain graph represented by ordered positive nondecreasing A degrees ending at |B|, every labeling has unique first A-empty index and last B-empty index, with absent-side sentinels. All A empty constraints collapse to the first A-empty B prefix by nested neighborhoods; all B empty constraints to the last B-empty A suffix. The local type words account for exactly all possible labels at fixed indices, and two-color inclusion-exclusion gives each opposite-side coverage generating factor. Conditions on the two sides separate, and disjointly summing products proves the identity for arbitrary size, including stars and p=q=1. A fresh self-contained verifier independently checks all four-label assignments on 111 profiles, 3,843,216 assignments, 1,651 coefficient positions, with matched P4/C4 polynomials. Tests are not substituted for the proof.

originality.rationale: The 2020 chain-graph Roman {2}-domination article treats a three-numerical-label minimum-weight invariant. The 2023 chain-graph total 2-rainbow article treats an additional positive-support condition and minimum weight. A full available four-label 2-rainbow polynomial for complete multipartite graphs covers only the complete-bipartite intersection with connected chain graphs; the noncomplete four-vertex path is excluded. The separately inspected Roman and ordinary domination polynomials on chain graphs count different objects. published-finding corpus and literature searches did not uncover an all-shape connected-chain ordinary 2-rainbow polynomial. Its novel content is a unique two-sided extremal empty-index factorization for all degrees and all weights, with residual bibliographic risks separately recorded.

value.rationale: A nontrivial structural, unique-index decomposition computes the whole weight distribution of a natural invariant on arbitrary connected Ferrers/chain graphs in polynomially many integer arithmetic operations. Existing scalar optimization of ordinary Roman {2} or total 2-rainbow domination does not yield full ordinary two-color enumeration; known complete multipartite two-rainbow formulas only address the complete-bipartite special case in this class. Every parameter of unbounded Ferrers shape is accommodated; no arbitrary finite slice, cosmetic renaming, or sole minimum-value corollary is claimed.
